Options
  --lang CODE            Display language (zh uses Simplified Chinese)
  --project PATH         Existing project directory (default: current directory)
  --json                 Stable JSON output; no interactive questions
  --help                 Show this help
  --version              Show the version

Setup automation
  setup --non-interactive --name NAME --purpose TEXT
        --learning manual|digest|off --max-items 1|2|3
phase: This version connects proposals, scoped decisions, isolated candidates, adoption branches and MCP handoff. It also supports bounded property checks, finite rules with exceptions, optional fixed exercises and review schedules, and local proposal jobs. It also supports external-key command signatures, writer process observations, separate-process checks, separately authorized canonical integration, provider APIs, explicit notifications and service registration.
guide_1:
1. What you keep
Verantyx is being designed to preserve the work, the reasons for decisions, and the ideas you want to learn. AI proposals and verified evidence are recorded separately.
guide_2:
2. How decisions work
The agent will first investigate the project and use existing decisions. It will return decisions that remain yours to make. A short request does not automatically mean that more questions are needed.
guide_3:
3. Learning is your choice
You can request learning items, receive a short task summary, or turn learning suggestions off. A saved explanation is not proof of your understanding.
guide_4:
4. Set up this project
Choose a display language, project name, purpose, and learning preference. Settings are saved locally in .verantyx/config.json after review. You can cancel with :q. No model account is required for this tutorial.
Start settings: verantyx setup
Check settings: verantyx status

console.help:
/editor · /context
/help Commands · /model Choose AI · /new New conversation · /dictionary Experience · /learn Learning · /status Settings · /quit Exit
Input → preserve original requests and context version → Vera proposal → when an editor is selected: Vera interpretation → separate editor proposal → Cross handoff check → up to two requested repairs → Vera answer and experience capture.
Originals are retained from the continued conversation; limits stop the request instead of silently omitting them. /context shows them. Applying code, tests and canonical adoption use the existing separate operations and permissions. /editor selects a separate editing model.
/details Last answer with evidence and record · /flow Workflow
Enter sends; Ctrl+J or trailing \+Enter inserts a newline. Multiline paste, ↑↓ history and Tab command completion are supported. Ctrl+C clears a draft, exits on empty input, or interrupts running work. VERANTYX_REDUCE_MOTION=1 disables animation; verantyx start --plain uses plain display.
/checks [on|off]: inspect or toggle asset checks on selected files
/work previews the latest candidate; /work execute runs it. /decide POINT CHOICE REASON records your decision. /target ITEM OWN|REVIEW|REFERENCE|DELEGATE REASON selects a learning target. /sovereignty shows recorded assets.
/work refresh [execute]
/paste: Paste multiple lines. Enter /send on its own line to submit, or /cancel to discard. Newlines during paste do not submit.
